name: private-use-identifier
sql: CREATE TABLE public.0(id int);CREATE TABLE public."other_notes"(id int);GRANT SELECT ON public."other_notes" TO authenticated;

name: search-path-grant
sql: CREATE TABLE audit.notes(id int);CREATE TABLE public.notes(id int);SET LOCAL search_path=audit,public;GRANT SELECT ON notes TO authenticated;

name: temporary-search-path
sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE notes(id int);CREATE TABLE public.notes(id int);GRANT SELECT ON notes TO authenticated;

name: select-into-prefix
sql: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT 1 AS id INTO public.notes;

name: drop-recreate
sql: CREATE TABLE public.notes(id int);GRANT SELECT ON public.notes TO authenticated;DROP TABLE public.notes;CREATE TABLE public.notes(id int);

name: grant-column-only
sql: CREATE TABLE public.notes(id int,private text);GRANT SELECT(id) ON public.notes TO authenticated;

name: dynamic-chr
sql: DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE chr(67)||'REATE TA'||'BLE public.notes(id int)'; END $$;

name: dynamic-replace
sql: DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE replace('CR#ATE TABL# public.notes(id int)', '#','E'); END $$;

name: unicode-custom-escape
sql: DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE U&'!0043REATE TABLE public.notes(id int)' UESCAPE '!'; END $$;

name: sql-prepare-exec

name: dynamic-comment-word
sql: DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE 'CREATE/**/TABLE public.notes(id int)'; END $$;

name: global-grant-before
sql: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO authenticated;CREATE TABLE public.notes(id int);

name: cte-insert-then-into
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS id) SELECT * INTO public.notes FROM t;
